a-adapted.how: Adapt an open-weight model on consented, doctor-reviewed data.
a-adapted.title: Adapted model becomes default in chat
a-adapted.why: Gate: it wins 70% of India evals or it does not ship.

a-cheeku-h.how: 250k H100-hours a run, about ₹2.3 cr at IndiaAI rates; ₹33 cr cap over 5 years.
a-cheeku-h.kpi: Beats the adapted model on India evals
a-cheeku-h.title: Train CHEEKU-H, our 15–22B health model
a-cheeku-h.why: India's own health model: our base weights plus specialist adapters, trained on consented family histories and ABDM records.

a-data.how: Aggregation layer, k-anonymity, consent purpose checks, audit log.
a-data.title: Consented data platform for cohorts
a-data.why: Insurers and states buy anonymised, consented signals. Never raw chats.

a-evals.how: Doctor-written cases across labs, Rx, symptoms, pregnancy, elders; 5 languages.
a-evals.title: India eval set: 5,000 cases in 5 languages
a-evals.why: No model ships unless it beats frontier APIs on our own evals.

a-gpu.how: Tuned open model on owned or IndiaAI-subsidised H100s.
a-gpu.kpi: p95 latency under 2.5 s at ₹0.10 an answer
a-gpu.title: Own GPUs serve chat: ₹0.30 → ₹0.10 an answer
a-gpu.why: Chat cost falls by two thirds overnight, which is what makes 20 free chats a day affordable.

a-reports.how: Per-lab templates, unit normalisation, confidence threshold, human fallback.
a-reports.kpi: 95% of values extracted right on the top 20 labs
a-reports.title: Production report reading on Indian lab formats
a-reports.why: Every report read into coded values is a fact in the family file.

a-risk-score.how: Adherence, retests and activity into a consented score; rewards only, never a premium rise.
a-risk-score.kpi: Score validated on one insurer's claims data
a-risk-score.title: Risk score that updates, for insurers
a-risk-score.why: The underwriting layer insurers do not have: a score that moves as families get healthier.

a-router.how: Model adapter, 4 urgency tiers, hard-stops before the model.
a-router.title: Frontier models behind our safety router
a-router.why: Safe answers on day one while our own model is trained.

a-scale.how: Read replicas, edge caching, India region, cost per user dashboards.
a-scale.kpi: p95 under 300 ms at 2x peak load
a-scale.title: Ready for 1 crore users
a-scale.why: Start the work when we cross 50 lakh so it is done before 1 crore.

a-six-paise.how: CHEEKU-H in production plus distillation for simple turns.
a-six-paise.title: Six paise an answer on our own model
a-six-paise.why: 4x cheaper than frontier APIs; the margin behind 20 free chats a day.

a-voice.how: Speech in and out for 5 languages, tuned on Indian accents and medical terms.
a-voice.title: Indic speech on our own stack
a-voice.why: Voice is the biggest serving cost line; 77% cheaper a minute on our stack.

b-corp-live.how: Direct sales to HR: ₹174 a month per employee, or the employer pays for everyone.
b-corp-live.title: Employers go live: Family plan at 30% off for staff
b-corp-live.why: Starts two months after the app passes 1 lakh users. ₹75 cr by 2031, 9% of revenue.

b-corp-team.how: Two account executives and one benefits-platform partnerships lead.
b-corp-team.title: Corporate sales: first 3 hires
b-corp-team.why: The team has to be in seat when the vertical opens.

b-diwali.how: Gift codes, HR dashboard for activations, Oct–Nov campaign.
b-diwali.title: First Diwali gifting season
b-diwali.why: Year-long Family plans bought in bulk, paid up front: cash arrives before revenue.

b-first-insurer.options: Large private general insurer · standalone health insurer · group cover through an employer client
b-first-insurer.title: Which insurer do we pilot with first?
b-first-insurer.why: The pilot decides the risk layer's first two years.

b-floater.how: Co-design with the pilot insurer; price from the live risk score; claims-light and cashless through our care network.
b-floater.title: Family floater with an insurer, priced from our risk score
b-floater.why: Families who stay healthy pay less every year. The insurer carries the risk; we price it and keep the family.

b-hr.how: List in flexi-benefits and group insurance catalogues.
b-hr.title: First HR benefits platform listing
b-hr.why: Benefits platforms put Cheeku in front of lakhs of covered lives; they keep 25%.

b-insurer-pilot.title: Insurer wellness pilot
b-insurer-pilot.why: Year one of the risk layer: a companion for the insurer's members.

b-insurer-rev.how: Cohort analytics linked to premiums and claims.
b-insurer-rev.title: Insurer risk-layer revenue starts

b-llm.how: API access to CHEEKU-H with India evals as the sales proof.
b-llm.title: Model licensing to hospitals and healthtechs

b-loi.how: Wellness-partner pitch with retention and adherence data.
b-loi.title: 1 insurer letter of intent
b-loi.why: Roadmap gate for the insurer track. Miss it and the track slows.

b-pendant-b2b.how: Bundle in the employer Family plan; insurer co-pay for members over 60; a Diwali gifting push.
b-pendant-b2b.kpi: 30% of pendants paid by an employer or insurer
b-pendant-b2b.title: Pendant for parents through employers and insurers
b-pendant-b2b.why: Employees buy it for parents as a benefit; insurers fund it for members over 60 because it lowers claims.

b-pricing.options: 30% off, employee pays · employer pays ₹174 a seat · flat ₹99 per employee a month, no family
b-pricing.title: Employer pricing: 30% off for staff, or a flat fee per seat?
b-pricing.why: The model assumes 30% off the Family plan, employees paying unless the employer covers everyone.

b-sandbox.how: Consented health passport and an updating risk score, inside the sandbox.
b-sandbox.title: IRDAI sandbox: the underwriting layer
b-sandbox.why: Year three of the insurer track: cover that gets cheaper as families get healthier.

b-state.how: Pilot with one state health mission, consented ABHA-linked memory.
b-state.title: First state licenses the memory layer on ABHA
b-state.why: Continuity of care for public programmes. ₹46 cr by 2031 from 4 states.

f-a-proof.how: Data room, cohort charts, eval results.
f-a-proof.title: Series A proof points in hand
f-a-proof.why: What the seed must buy: 5.9 lakh monthly users, 10,000+ payers, 25% D30, care booked weekly.

f-bridge.options: Venture debt · insider bridge · deeper cuts in 2031
f-bridge.title: Line up a ₹10–15 cr bridge option for the bear case
f-bridge.why: In the bear case cash dips to about −₹7 cr in Sep 2031.

f-incorporate.how: Private limited, founder agreements, ESOP pool, DPIIT recognition.
f-incorporate.title: Incorporate the company
f-incorporate.why: Not yet incorporated. The seed, legal texts and partner contracts need the entity.

f-indiaai.how: IndiaAI Mission compute application with the eval plan.
f-indiaai.title: Apply for IndiaAI compute
f-indiaai.why: H100s at about ₹92 an hour make our own model affordable.

f-low.how: Marketing to 35%, model spend halved, hiring frozen until the round lands.
f-low.title: Lowest cash month: hold the 6-month runway rule
f-low.why: Cash dips to about ₹11 cr just before the Series A. Under 6 months of cash, cuts start.

f-seed.title: Close the seed: ₹26 cr
f-seed.why: 17 months of runway to the Series A.

f-seed-terms.options: 17% at ₹127 cr pre · 20% at ₹104 cr pre · 22.4% at ₹90 cr pre
f-seed-terms.title: Seed terms: aim for 20%, walk away above 22.4%
f-seed-terms.why: Same ₹26 cr in every case; only the price moves. 22.4% is the ceiling we show investors.

f-series-a.title: Series A: ₹70 cr
f-series-a.why: Funds the adapted model, voice, tier 2 and the insurer track.

f-series-b.title: Series B: ₹150 cr
f-series-b.why: Funds CHEEKU-H, the pendant and the institution sales team. Last round in the plan.

f-update.how: Auto-filled from the analytics stack on the 5th of each month.
f-update.title: Monthly investor update on 8 numbers
f-update.why: MAU, D30 retention, paying share, bookings per user, CAC, cost per answer, eval win rate, safety incidents.

g-cac.how: Monthly CAC review; the runway rule cuts paid spend first.
g-cac.title: Keep blended cost per new user under ₹60
g-cac.why: Paid LTV/CAC is only 1.8x by 2031; organic carries the model.

g-cities.how: ₹40 lakh a month, ₹120 paid CAC, creators and parent groups.
g-cities.title: Launch in Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad
g-cities.why: Wave one: adults caring for parents, and new parents.

g-crore.title: 1 crore monthly users: replace Google for health at home
g-crore.why: The point where Cheeku is the default first stop for a health question in Indian homes.

g-lakh.title: 1 lakh consumer users
g-lakh.why: Also the trigger for the employer vertical.

g-pages.how: Answer pages from real questions, reviewed by doctors, in 5 languages later.
g-pages.kpi: 1 lakh monthly organic visits by Q3
g-pages.title: Health answer pages that rank
g-pages.why: Organic does the heavy lifting: 49% of new users in 2027, 74% by 2031.

g-referral.how: Invite from a report or Rx check, caregiver view.
g-referral.kpi: 0.3 invites accepted per active a month
g-referral.title: Invite your parents loop
g-referral.why: The launch ICP cares for parents; the parents are the next users.

g-retention.how: Cohort dashboard, weekly retention review, cut paid if it slips.
g-retention.title: 25% day-30 retention before we scale spend
g-retention.why: Gate on the roadmap: no spend scale-up before the habit holds.

g-tier2.how: Voice in 5 languages, regional creators, WhatsApp-first.
g-tier2.title: Tier 2 cities with voice
g-tier2.why: Wave two: every member, every language.

p-abha.how: ABDM PHR integration, consent artefacts per member, records land as typed facts.
p-abha.kpi: 25% of families link at least one ABHA
p-abha.title: ABHA link and ABDM record pull
p-abha.why: 79.7 cr ABHA ids, records stuck in silos. Consented pulls fill the family file without uploads.

p-billing.how: Store billing for Family, Solo and Daily Pass; UPI checkout on web at 2% fees.
p-billing.kpi: First paid Family plan through the store
p-billing.title: Real billing: store subscriptions and UPI on web
p-billing.why: Plans run on a stand-in today. Paying share is the first number investors check.

p-claims.how: Pre-auth packet built from records; hospital network status; a claim tracker in the thread.
p-claims.title: Claims help in chat: cashless pre-auth from the family file
p-claims.why: The worst moment with insurance is a claim. If Cheeku fills it from the family file, families never leave.

p-device-qa.how: Run every core flow on 3 iPhones and 3 Androids from the Vercel and native builds.
p-device-qa.kpi: Every launch flow signed off on 6 devices
p-device-qa.title: Device QA of V1 on iPhone and Android
p-device-qa.why: Two layout bugs looked fine in the browser and broke on iOS. Device checks are part of done.

p-fall.how: On-device fall model; an SOS button; a call ladder to family, then a local emergency partner.
p-fall.kpi: Under 1 false alarm a month per pendant
p-fall.title: Fall detection and SOS into the family thread
p-fall.why: Children worry most about a fall nobody sees. An alert with location and the parent's file in the thread is the reason to buy.

p-food.how: Indian meals in real portions fit to the person's numbers; fitness classes suggested from the plan.
p-food.kpi: 40% of weekly actives log a meal or class
p-food.title: Food and fitness in the daily plan
p-food.why: Daily reasons to open the app between consults.

p-home.how: Services hub on home, ordered by open loops in the family memory; one checkout for every service.
p-home.kpi: 40% of paying families use 2+ services a quarter
p-home.title: One home for every service, ranked by the family's memory
p-home.why: Labs, doctors, medicines, fitness and cover each live in a different app today. One screen that knows the family beats five that do not.

p-household.how: Invite flows for parents and spouse, caregiver alerts.
p-household.title: Household invites onto the Family plan
p-household.why: One member brings the household; Family plan ARPU is 2.5x Solo.

p-id.how: Consent-based sign-in for partners; ABHA linked; per-partner data scopes from the consent ledger.
p-id.title: Cheeku ID: one login across partners, ABHA and insurers
p-id.why: When partners and insurers accept our login and consent, the ecosystem runs through us.

p-insurer-app.how: Reward ledger, insurer-funded retests, consent per purpose.
p-insurer-app.title: Insurer member experience: rewards and funded tests
p-insurer-app.why: The pilot needs an in-app experience the insurer can show its members.

p-launch.how: Launch with the daily plan, Rx check, care booked in chat and fitness in 200 cities.
p-launch.title: Public launch: the daily health companion
p-launch.why: Day one of the plan: 30,000 monthly users in the launch month across five metros.

p-memory-v2.how: Timeline per member, trends by system, open loops, corrections.
p-memory-v2.kpi: Median family file: 25+ facts after 6 months
p-memory-v2.title: Memory timeline v2: every event, every member, over years
p-memory-v2.why: The memory is the moat. Make its depth visible so families feel what they would lose.

p-pendant.how: Launch in the 5 wave-one metros through the Family plan.
p-pendant.title: Pendant launch for elders
p-pendant.why: 6,000 units a month by 2031 at ₹4,999; also the strongest elder-care moat.

p-pendant-partner.how: Partner builds the device; we own voice, memory and safety.
p-pendant-partner.kpi: Partner signed with unit cost under ₹4,000
p-pendant-partner.title: Pendant: sign a hardware partner
p-pendant-partner.why: Elders who will never type get a voice companion that shares the family memory.

p-pendant-pilot.how: 1,000 units to Family plan members with parents over 65; weekly calls; a return-and-fix loop.
p-pendant-pilot.title: Pendant pilot with 1,000 elder parents
p-pendant-pilot.why: Proves daily wear, battery life and the alert loop before mass production.

p-rename.how: Ops rename: app name, bundle id, domains, store assets, legal entity references.
p-rename.kpi: No old name left in app, store or emails
p-rename.title: Rename to Cheeku AI everywhere
p-rename.why: Store listing, bundle id, emails and legal texts must carry one name before review.

p-rx-ten.how: License a drug database, map brands to salts, MD signs each rule, every flag cites a source.
p-rx-ten.kpi: 10 of 10 checks signed, 0 unsafe flags in review
p-rx-ten.title: Prescription check: all 10 checks signed, licensed drug data
p-rx-ten.why: The medication ledger is built; production needs licensed drug data and clinician sign-off on all 10 checks.

p-store.how: Bundle id, privacy labels, health disclaimers, review notes, staged rollout.
p-store.kpi: Approved on App Store and Play Store
p-store.title: Store release: review and submit
p-store.why: No launch without both stores approving a health app with consent and safety copy in order.

p-wallet.how: UPI autopay; a family balance; GST invoices per member; employer and insurer credits land here.
p-wallet.kpi: 30% of care and fitness spend paid from the wallet
p-wallet.title: Family wallet: one balance for plans, care and cover
p-wallet.why: One payment method and one history across every service makes switching away expensive.

p-wearables.how: Health Connect and HealthKit; readings go to the member's memory.
p-wearables.title: Wearables sync
p-wearables.why: Steps, sleep and BP flow in without typing.

p-weekly.how: Sunday 60-second review, retest due card, change card after results.
p-weekly.kpi: 30% of actives finish a weekly review
p-weekly.title: Weekly review and quarterly retest loop
p-weekly.why: The daily loop builds habit; the weekly and 90-day loops prove it works.

p-whatsapp.how: Shareable Rx checks and report summaries; ask Cheeku from a WhatsApp thread.
p-whatsapp.kpi: 15% of new users arrive from a share
p-whatsapp.title: WhatsApp: share answers, ask from chat
p-whatsapp.why: Answers and reports already travel on WhatsApp. Make that the growth loop.

r-ads.how: Sponsored products and services, labelled, relevance-checked.
r-ads.title: Labelled ads in non-urgent chats
r-ads.why: ₹87 cr by 2031; never in red-flag chats.

r-bookings.how: Partner price plus 10–13% take, one price, one slot.
r-bookings.kpi: 3% of users book each month in 2027
r-bookings.title: Care bookings earn our markup in chat

r-fitness.how: Markup of 15%, at least ₹25 a class.
r-fitness.kpi: 0.5% of users book a class each month
r-fitness.title: Fitness classes at 15% markup
r-fitness.why: ₹41 cr by 2031 from classes in 200 cities.

r-listings.how: Licensed partner, comparison from the family's own needs.
r-listings.title: Insurance listings in the app
r-listings.why: ₹61 cr by 2031 from 0.3 → 0.7 policies per 1,000 users a month.

r-price.options: Raise for new users only · raise for all with 3 months notice · hold and add a premium tier
r-price.title: Raise prices 10% as memory deepens?
r-price.why: The plan assumes +10% in 2029, +20% in 2030, +30% in 2031 over launch.

r-profit.kpi: Every month EBITDA positive after this
r-profit.title: EBITDA positive for good
r-profit.why: Self-funding from here; no round needed after Series B.

r-subs.how: Plans, upgrades and Daily Pass at the free limit.
r-subs.title: Subscriptions live: Family ₹249, Solo ₹99, Daily Pass ₹29
r-subs.why: Paying share grows from 1.1% to 3.0%; many upgrade after hitting 20 chats a day.

r-web-upi.how: Web checkout, renewal reminders, family billing.
r-web-upi.kpi: 20% of plans paid on web by Dec 2028
r-web-upi.title: Move plans to UPI on web: fees 15% → 2%
r-web-upi.why: Half of plans on web by 2031 saves about 6 points of margin on subscriptions.

s-care-cats.how: Add categories through the same provider layer.
s-care-cats.title: More care: dietitians, physio, elder care at home
s-care-cats.why: Roadmap gate: 6% of users book monthly.

s-doctors.how: Partner booking API, pre-consult summary from memory, Rx back into the ledger.
s-doctors.kpi: Consult booked to Rx filed in under 24 h
s-doctors.title: Doctor consults through registered partners
s-doctors.why: Telemedicine rules 2020: consults only with registered doctors on the partner network.

s-fitness.how: Discover, book and track classes in the app.
s-fitness.title: Fitness and healthy living in 200 cities
s-fitness.why: Partnership with India's leading fitness platform; 15% markup per class.

s-hospitals.how: Packages with hospital chains, surgery counselling from memory.
s-hospitals.kpi: ₹20 cr GMV in the first year
s-hospitals.title: Hospital partners for procedures and second opinions
s-hospitals.why: High-value bookings once families trust Cheeku with big decisions.

s-lab-live.how: Partner pricing plus our markup, paid in chat, results filed back to the member.
s-lab-live.kpi: First paid home collection end to end
s-lab-live.title: Lab partner live with markup and payments
s-lab-live.why: Care bookings are the largest revenue engine. They must work on day one.

s-medicines.how: Pharmacy partner, Rx from the ledger, generics suggested.
s-medicines.kpi: 20% of chronic patients refill through Cheeku
s-medicines.title: Medicines delivered from chat
s-medicines.why: Refills are the most frequent need for families caring for parents.

s-pincodes.how: Provider API layer; swapping a partner touches only that layer.
s-pincodes.title: Care in 12,000+ pincodes: labs, doctors, medicines
s-pincodes.why: Supply on day one through partner APIs, at zero cost to build.

s-second.how: Same provider API, routing by price, slot and SLA.
s-second.kpi: Two live partners in labs, doctors, medicines
s-second.title: A second partner in every care category
s-second.why: Reliance on one partner is a medium risk on the register.

s-sla.how: Partner SLAs, webhooks, nudges when a result is late.
s-sla.kpi: 90% of lab results filed within 24 h
s-sla.title: Result back in the thread within 24 hours
s-sla.why: The promise is the loop: book, test, result explained, next step.

t-b2b.title: Institution sales team for insurers and states
t-b2b.why: B2B team grows from 1 to 22 by 2031.

t-deepesh.title: Deepesh joins as co-founder and CBO
t-deepesh.why: GTM, enterprise sales and distribution: Pine Labs and Practo.

t-engs.title: Four founding engineers
t-engs.why: Mobile, backend, infra: the team that takes V1 to 5 lakh users.

t-esop.options: 10% + 5% as modelled · 12% up front, no top-up
t-esop.title: ESOP pool: 10% before seed, 5% top-up before A
t-esop.why: Founding hires in 2027 need meaningful equity.

t-hundred.how: Second layer of leaders in every function.
t-hundred.title: 100 people

t-md.how: Part-time MD lead first, full-time by Q3.
t-md.title: MD clinical lead and two reviewers
t-md.why: Every rule and every Rx check needs a clinical sign-off owner.

t-ml.how: Head of ML, eval lead, Indic voice engineer.
t-ml.title: Head of ML and the eval team
t-ml.why: 5 people in AI and data by Dec 2027.

tr-audit.title: External security audit and pen test
tr-audit.why: Breach risk is high impact. Employers and insurers will ask.

tr-broking.how: IRDAI corporate agent (composite) registration, a principal officer, compliant sales flows in chat.
tr-broking.title: Corporate agent licence to sell cover in the app
tr-broking.why: Listing policies is not enough to own the insurance relationship. A licence lets us advise and sell within IRDAI rules.

tr-cdsco.how: Regulatory counsel, classification, clinical evidence plan.
tr-cdsco.title: CDSCO path for the pendant and any diagnostic claim
tr-cdsco.why: App and pendant stay a wellness companion until certified.

tr-clinical.how: Rule registry with signer and date, weekly review of flagged answers.
tr-clinical.kpi: 100% of rules signed; review every week
tr-clinical.title: Clinician-signed rules and weekly doctor review
tr-clinical.why: Rules decide, the model explains. Rules need a doctor's signature.

tr-dpdp.how: Done in V1: migration 0041, privacy alerts, breach runbook.
tr-dpdp.title: DPDP readiness: consent ledger, privacy requests, breach plan
tr-dpdp.why: Consent per purpose, a named Grievance Officer and a 90-day request clock.

tr-hosting.how: Move database, storage and functions to an India region.
tr-hosting.title: India-region hosting
tr-hosting.why: Health data stays in India for DPDP, insurers and states.

tr-iso.title: ISO 27001 for employer and insurer contracts
tr-iso.why: Procurement gate for insurers, large employers and states.

m-distribution.name: Employer and insurer distribution
m-distribution.thesis: Companies, benefits platforms and insurers bring families in at near-zero CAC on multi-year contracts.

m-ecosystem.name: Connected ecosystem in one app
m-ecosystem.thesis: Records, answers, labs, doctors, medicines, fitness, cover and devices behind one login, one wallet and one family memory. Every service added makes the others harder to leave.

m-habit.name: Daily habit
m-habit.thesis: One useful nudge every morning and 20 free chats a day. The reason families open Cheeku before Google.

m-insurance.name: Insurance risk infrastructure
m-insurance.thesis: We help insurers carry family health risk: the family memory becomes a live risk score, cover is priced from it through the IRDAI sandbox, and claims run from the family file. Licences, data and insurer contracts a newcomer cannot buy.

m-memory.name: Family health memory
m-memory.thesis: Years of each family's reports, medicines and choices in one place. Leaving means starting from zero.

m-model.name: Our own India health model
m-model.thesis: Trained on consented family histories and ABDM records. Cheaper per answer and better on India evals than frontier APIs.

m-pendant.name: Pendant for elder parents
m-pendant.thesis: A wearable for parents who will never install an app. Falls, SOS, vitals and medicine reminders flow into the memory their children already use. Hardware, CDSCO clearance and the family habit together are very hard to copy.

m-supply.name: Care network in chat
m-supply.thesis: Labs, doctors, medicines and fitness in 12,000+ pincodes and 200 cities, booked from the same memory.

m-trust.name: Consent, safety and regulation
m-trust.thesis: DPDP-grade consent ledger, clinician-signed rules, IRDAI sandbox and a CDSCO path. Slow and costly to copy.

r-advice.mitigation: Hard-stops before the model, clinician-signed rules, India evals, weekly doctor review.
r-advice.signal: Flagged answers in weekly review rise
r-advice.title: Wrong or unsafe advice

r-breach.mitigation: Row-level security per member, India hosting, audits, breach runbook.
r-breach.signal: Pen test high findings, unusual access
r-breach.title: Health data breach

r-cac.mitigation: Organic-first channels; the runway rule cuts paid spend first.
r-cac.title: Paid growth gets costly

r-corp.mitigation: Benefits platforms and gifting run alongside direct sales.
r-corp.title: Employer sales take longer than planned

r-focus.mitigation: Owners per lane, gates that stop tracks, weekly sync on this board.
r-focus.signal: More than 3 open P0s per founder in a quarter
r-focus.title: Founder bandwidth across too many tracks

r-institutions.mitigation: Bear case delays deals 6 months; families and employers are 79% of 2031 revenue.
r-institutions.title: Institutions buy slowly

r-model.mitigation: Adapted model first; train from scratch only if it wins; ₹33 cr cap.
r-model.signal: Adapted model under 60% eval wins in Q4 2027
r-model.title: Own model costs more or slips

r-partner.mitigation: Provider API layer is built; a second partner per category by 2028.
r-partner.signal: Partner SLA misses two months running
r-partner.title: Reliance on one care partner

r-reg.mitigation: Consent ledger, no diagnosis claims, companion positioning, counsel from seed.
r-reg.signal: New DPDP rules or telemedicine guidance
r-reg.title: Regulation tightens

r-retention.mitigation: Memory gets more useful every month; no spend scale-up before 25% day-30.
r-retention.signal: Day-30 retention under 20% for two cohorts
r-retention.title: Families do not stay

r-runway.mitigation: Six-month runway rule, proof points tracked monthly, bridge options ready.
r-runway.signal: Proof points behind plan by Q3 2027
r-runway.title: Series A slips past the lowest cash month

r-rx.mitigation: Never says stop or rates the doctor; licensed drug data, signed rules, a source on every flag.
r-rx.signal: Any unsafe flag reaching a family
r-rx.title: Prescription check is wrong
